title: First hearing in Mehmet Yıldız's case
paragraphs: The first hearing has been held against Capital News correspondent Mehmet Yıldız on charge of violating the secrecy of the investigation.

According to the indictment, Mehmet Yıldız violated the confidentiality of the investigation with the report of a murder investigation published on 3 November 2025. The sentence is carried out: the Turkish Penal Code 285 (infringement of the confidentiality of the investigation).
The trial was held on April 2, 2026 in front of Ankara's 12th Criminal Court. The court postponed the trial until July 23, 2026.
In the Mehmet Yıldız case, Attorney Orhan Bilgin said the defence witnesses were not allowed to be heard.
Mehmet Yıldız is working as an Ankara correspondent at a broadcast agency called Capital News. Journalists' organisations said the case could have a deterrent effect on freedom of the press.
The prosecutor's office will present its original debate at the next hearing. Mehmet Yıldız is being tried without arrest.
